optimizedDescription.value: Format-agnostic AST selectors target nodes for deltas, validations, and metadata extraction.

optimizedContext.value:
# Selector model
## Rules
- Selector YAML fields: type required; matches, contains, parent, index, where, level optional.
- type must exist in target ArtifactParser.nodeTypes(). matches regex case-insensitive on node.label; contains regex case-insensitive on node.value.
- parent recursively constrains nearest ancestor; supports nested parent selectors.
- index zero-based for array-item/sequence-item; where object fields regex case-insensitive for object items; index XOR where.
- level matches Markdown section heading level only; nodes without level fail level selector.
- Addressable types: Markdown document/section/paragraph/list/list-item/code-block/thematic-break; JSON document/object/property/array/array-item; YAML document/mapping/pair/sequence/sequence-item; text document/paragraph/line.
- Delta modified/removed selector requires exactly one match, else DeltaApplicationError. Validation and metadata extraction process every match.
- Zero validation matches pass vacuously. Added position.after/before zero match warns then inserts end parent scope.
## Constraints
- Unknown type parse validation error.
- label feeds matches; scalar value feeds contains.
- parent is full recursive selector.
